_about: Public-domain Samuel Lavington, Independent minister of Bideford, for the Word Hoard: God the Giver of Victory, his Sermons and Other Discourses, and his Sacramental Meditations. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 120 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
